trace.command: cd / && npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz >/tmp/npm.log 2>&1; tail -2 /tmp/npm.log; noacg --version; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; which certutil || apt-get install -y libnss3-tools >/dev/null 2>&1; mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done) </dev/null; noacg doctor
